source_record.title: Working Student Marketing - Content Creation
source_record.description:
Your mission

We are looking for a curious and hands-on Working Student Marketing to join our marketing team at deeploi.

Most of our future customers will find us through AI platforms rather than a search results page. That is why we are rebuilding our content around this shift, from long-form articles in our magazine to LinkedIn and AI-visibility research. Together with our marketing team, you will create the content that gets us there and see its impact within weeks.

Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in content marketing at a moment when the entire discipline is being redefined.

  • Write engaging blog content for deeploi.io that speaks to our target audience of IT decision-makers at SMBs
  • Help optimize our content for visibility in AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, working with tools like Asky
  • Support the creation of social media content, primarily for LinkedIn, including research, copy, and visuals
  • Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting, and editing, with the judgment to tell a strong draft from a plausible-sounding weak one
  • Collaborate closely with our marketing team on content ideas, formats, and topics, with room to bring your own initiative to the mix
  • Support content distribution and light performance tracking across channels


Your profile

  • First hands-on experience in content creation (writing blog posts, articles, or similar text-based content) 
  • Comfortable working with AI tools, ideally already familiar with tools like Asky, Peec AI, or similar AI-visibility/GEO platforms 
  • Experience with Figma, CMS systems (e.g. Webflow) and social media content, ideally LinkedIn in a professional or B2B context, is a plus 
  • Curious, proactive, and excited to help shape how a fast-growing B2B SaaS company shows up in both traditional and AI-driven search 
  • Enrolled as a student for the duration of the role 

  • German at native-speaker level, with a strong feel for tone and style, and fluent English (C1 or higher)


Why us?

  • High impact and ownership from day one - your work will directly shape deeploi's content strategy.
  • A small, ambitious team in Berlin and Munich - backed by top European VCs including Atomico and Cherry Ventures.
  • Competitive salary
  • Well-equipped offices in Berlin and Munich.
